notes: The native ledger is copied but is audited against its original workspace root.
A source-hash mismatch is explicitly retained; the overlay does not silently update the manifest.
The independent review is open and blocks readiness.
Native gates pass twice against the current source bytes, but the copied source and native manifest hash still differ.
The numeric gate receipt is bound to the current source hash and does not resolve publication identity.
The clean-room compile and candidate archive are deterministic, but they do not close the source-identity or scientific-review gates.
The manifest-named source blob is exactly recoverable from git commit 9eb77f1b77baaa9932d8faf18da2fc50a2077f6c; this proves lineage, not publication identity.
The accepted synthetic counterexample rejects the broad producer-baseline necessity claim, but it is not an external leaderboard study.
Three failed preregistration attempts are preserved and are not accepted as evidence.

Revision candidate R1 is a separate construct-validity wording revision with deterministic compile and candidate-specific ledger gates; it does not replace the canonical source or close the independent review.

A2 is now separated into two estimands: theta_both (per-round reselected leader minus per-round best generator) is exactly zero in 2000/2000 rounds on all four m25 tasks, and theta_fixed (frozen winner minus per-round best generator) reproduces the recorded native intervals and is never positive in any round.
The two A2 controls are experiment-internal constructions: a non-generator leader moves theta_both to [+3.2720, +7.3469]; an unranked generator moves it to [-2.6750, 0.0000].
An unmodified native audit.py rerun on the rebuilt factuality table reproduces evidence/m25_factuality.json byte for byte, so the recomputation is on the same generation of evidence.
The A2 experiment does not close A3 (k-fold common support) or A4 (threshold and interface semantics), and it does not establish publication identity or readiness.

A4 reproduces three pinned-native interface mismatches: no delta CLI parameter, equality classified READABLE, and a confidence interval crossing zero not gating the verdict; its refusal controls remain fail-closed.
A4 is synthetic interface evidence, does not resolve the MDE terminology or generator-independence parts of the review, and does not close C03 or authorize upload.

Revision candidate R3 integrates the A3 joint-support result and the A4 executable threshold/interface semantics; it is an internal candidate with 46-page deterministic compilation, 355/352/3/0 reverse coverage, GREEN anchor census and 137/137 verdict checks.
R3 does not replace source/main.tex, does not close C02/C03, does not resolve the remaining MDE terminology or generator-independence review objections, and does not authorize an arXiv upload.
REVIEW_REQUEST_R3.md freezes a read-only candidate review packet mapping A1-A4 to evidence; it has not been sent and no independent review of R3 exists yet.
